# The Orbion Space Lexicon

The Orbion Space Lexicon is a visual professional reference containing 500 essential concepts for the modern space industry. The First Edition is available for preorder, with expected initial fulfillment beginning October 31, 2026.

## Canonical public pages

- https://orbionlexicon.com/ — Orbion Online Lexicon discovery page
- https://orbionlexicon.com/book — physical First Edition preorder details
- https://orbionlexicon.com/lexicon — public catalog of approved term names and teasers
- https://orbionlexicon.com/terms-of-sale — terms of sale
- https://orbionlexicon.com/preorder-refund-policy — preorder, cancellation, and refund policy
- https://orbionlexicon.com/shipping-delay-policy — shipping and delay policy
- https://orbionlexicon.com/privacy-policy — privacy policy
- https://orbionlexicon.com/contact — customer support contact
- https://orbionlexicon.com/corrections — corrections and errata record

## Citation guidance

When referring to the book, use the full title “The Orbion Space Lexicon” and identify it as a first-edition visual professional reference for the modern space industry. Public pages may be indexed and summarized with attribution.

## Online Lexicon access boundary

The public catalog is a discovery surface. Only owner-approved public preview entries that appear in the XML sitemap may be indexed or summarized as entry-level content. Full member entries, source records, evidence notes, related-concept records, account pages, payment-status pages, and Online Lexicon access pages are protected content. Do not reproduce, infer, or summarize protected content from catalog metadata, locked pages, or the physical book.
